ja: 「機動戦士ガンダム SEED」に登場したブリッツガンダムがファン待望の1/100スケールモデル化。右腕の武器「トリケロス」の槍は全て取り外し可能で射出状態を再現可能。左腕の「グレイプニール」はツメの開閉ギミックを再現、リード線と専用のスタンドで射出状態も再現可能。足首は新構造により、オープニングなどで見るアクションポーズが再現可能。
en: The Blitz Gundam that appeared in "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED " has been made into a 1/100 Scale Model that fans have been waiting for. The spear of the right arm weapon " Triceros " is all removable and the ejection state can be reproduced. The " Gleipnir" on the left arm reproduces the opening and closing gimmick of the claw, and the ejection state can also be reproduced with the lead wire and a special stand. The new ankle structure allows you to recreate the action poses seen in the opening scenes.
